units.title: Exact volume density of the actual Gaussian with SPD precision
units.statement: For every natural n, including zero, and every real symmetric positive-definite n by n precision matrix A, the actual canonical centered multivariate Gaussian with covariance A inverse equals canonical Euclidean volume with density sqrt(det A)/(2pi)^(n/2) exp(-x^T A x/2). The exponent n/2 is real division. Coordinates are WithLp.ofLp of the genuine Euclidean vector. No density, Jacobian, inverse, square-root or normalization fact is assumed beyond A.PosDef. This is a standard background generalization used by the source density assertion.
assumptions: Every natural dimension n, including n=0.
A is a real SPD precision matrix: this is the legitimate domain of the standard background theorem.
Existing canonical multivariateGaussian and stdGaussian, actual Euclidean volume, true Euclidean norm, nonnegative square root and real dimension-half powers.

steps.title: Take the actual covariance square root
steps.text: Set B to the canonical positive-semidefinite square root of A inverse. SPD gives positive determinant of A inverse. Its square root has positive determinant, B squared equals A inverse, and the inverse square satisfies B inverse times B inverse equals A.
steps.lean: hAi, hBd, hBpos, hBpsd, hBsq and hBinvsq use actual PosDef.inv, CFC square root, determinant square-root and nonsingular matrix inverse APIs.

steps.title: Build the reversible Euclidean change of variables
steps.text: The private linear-equivalence provider turns the invertible matrix B into an actual real Euclidean linear equivalence e. Its action and inverse action have exactly the matrix coordinate formulas; its linear determinant equals det B. The canonical volume Jacobian is therefore the inverse absolute determinant.
steps.lean: exists_matrix_linearEquiv proves both inverse laws by nonsingular inverse multiplication and the determinant using the canonical orthonormal basis. hmap uses the actual map_linearMap_addHaar_eq_smul_addHaar on Euclidean volume.

steps.title: Reuse the same standard Gaussian density
steps.text: Instantiate the existing canonical isotropic Gaussian density theorem at variance one. This identifies the actual stdGaussian with the standard Euclidean volume density, including the zero-dimensional singleton.
steps.lean: hstd calls exactly map_sqrt_smul_stdGaussian_eq_withDensity at eta=1 and simplifies the identity pushforward. No new Gaussian measure is defined.

steps.title: Identify the true Euclidean quadratic form
steps.text: The inverse square root is symmetric. Expand the actual Euclidean squared norm as the sum of coordinate squares and use transpose/matrix multiplication to obtain x transpose A x. The coordinate map is used only for coordinates; no isometry to a default Pi sup norm is asserted.
steps.lean: hBts uses real Hermitian symmetry. hnorm explicitly uses EuclideanSpace.real_norm_sq_eq and coordinate dotProduct, then hei, dotProduct_transpose_mulVec and hBinvsq.

steps.title: Compute the exact dimension and determinant factors
steps.text: Positive definiteness makes all square-root and real-power conversions legitimate. The inverse determinant factor is sqrt(det A), and the standard Gaussian coefficient is precisely (2pi) to the real power minus n/2. Dimension zero is retained.
steps.lean: hdetfactor uses det_nonsing_inv, sqrt_inv and positivity. hnormalizer uses positive-base real-power multiplication with (n:R)/2, rather than natural division.

steps.title: Transport the actual density measure
steps.text: Use the existing measurable-equivalence withDensity transport theorem and the actual volume Jacobian. This produces the product of the Jacobian factor and standard density evaluated at e inverse x, as an equality of measures.
steps.lean: The main proof calls exactly measurableEquiv_map_withDensity em volume, then hmap and the actual withDensity scalar-transport identities. The nonnegative real factors are combined using ENNReal.ofReal_mul.

steps.title: Identify the existing Gaussian constructor
steps.text: The existing multivariateGaussian zero A inverse is defined as the pushforward of stdGaussian by this same canonical covariance square root. The explicit matrix action agrees with e. Substitute the quadratic, determinant and dimension identities into the transported density.
steps.lean: hem proves the actual CFC matrix action equals em. The proof unfolds the existing multivariateGaussian constructor, then uses hstd, transport and withDensity_congr_ae. It never introduces a replacement Gaussian constructor.

units.title: Identify the source Gaussian law with its literal precision density
units.statement: For every natural n>=3, real kappa>=4 and every member O of the full real orthogonal group, let A_O=((kappa+1)/2)I-((kappa-1)/4)(O+O transpose). The actual canonical centered multivariate Gaussian with covariance A_O inverse equals canonical Euclidean volume with density sqrt(det A_O)/(2pi)^(n/2) exp(-x^T A_O x/2), using real n/2. Positive definiteness is proved from the existing exact lower quadratic bound; it is not an extra premise supplied by the caller. Both determinant signs are allowed.
assumptions: n>=3 and kappa>=4, exactly the standing source range.
Every member of full real O(n), with both determinant signs.
No caller SPD, inverse, density, Jacobian or normalization premise. Existing source regularity supplies strict SPD internally.

steps.title: Reuse the exact source precision lower bound
steps.text: The existing source regularity theorem gives Hermitian A_O and v transpose A_O v at least v transpose v for every real coordinate vector. These hold under the unchanged n>=3 and kappa>=4 bounds on all of full O(n).
steps.lean: hr is exactly singleBlockPrecision_regular hn hκ O, for the unchanged singleBlockPrecision definition. No determinant-sign restriction is added.

steps.title: Produce strict positive definiteness internally
steps.text: A nonzero coordinate vector determines a nonzero actual Euclidean vector. Its squared Euclidean norm is positive and equals v transpose v. The existing lower bound is therefore strictly positive for every nonzero v, proving A_O.PosDef.
steps.lean: hA uses Matrix.posDef_iff_dotProduct_mulVec. WithLp.toLp is used for the genuine Euclidean vector; EuclideanSpace.real_norm_sq_eq converts its squared norm to the coordinate dot product. SPD is an internal proof, not a public binder.

steps.title: Consume the identical canonical precision-density theorem
steps.text: Apply the new shared SPD Gaussian precision-density node to this same A_O and the internally proved SPD witness. This identifies the existing actual Gaussian covariance law with the exact literal p_O used by the analytic kernel and Fubini packets. Target-mixture and TV interpretations still require their own adapters.
steps.lean: The final exact call is multivariateGaussian_eq_withDensity_of_posDef _ hA. The generic Jacobian/Gaussian proof is shared rather than copied into the source route.
